subject: MAP-linked tiered private-offer: evaluation sprint -> staged commit plan

Cc: procurement@hawksight.com
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: MAP + private offer: proposed sprint & staged commit approach

Kim —

Thanks again for the demo last week. HawkSight leadership liked the latency profile and the cost/throughput projections, but procurement wants a concrete path from evaluation to a private offer on the AWS Marketplace before signing.

We put together a short asks list:
- 4-week evaluation sprint (pilot) with performance gates (p99 < 120ms, batch QPS target)
- If gates met, a 6-month pilot PO with a staged commit: 20% initial commit, ramp to 100% over 3 quarters
- MAP milestones to gate discounts at ramp points (10% at 50% commit, 18% at 100%)
- Marketplace private offer (AWS) publication timeline pinned to the commit schedule so our procurement team can accept via private offer flow

Can Redwood provide a MAP worksheet (milestones + acceptance criteria) and a draft private offer tiering table we can present internally? I'll loop in procurement and our AWS partner rep once we have something concrete.

Attachments: HawkSight-MAP-v3.xlsx (initial internal MAP draft)

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Head of Product
HawkSight Systems
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP + private offer: proposed sprint & staged commit approach

Daniel —

Appreciate the clear asks and the MAP draft. High-level response and next steps below.

1) Evaluation sprint (4 weeks)
   - We agree to a 4-week pilot with two hard gates:
     a) Functional/quality gate: model outputs meet your eval prompts (we'll co-author ~50 prompts)
     b) Performance gate: p99 latency <= 120ms on your target traffic profile (we'll mirror with a 2-node dedicated pool)

2) Staged commit & discounts
   - Proposed private-offer tiers (draft):
     • Stage A (Initial): 20% commit -> 8% marketplace discount + reserved capacity priority
     • Stage B (Ramp): 50% commit -> cumulative 12% discount
     • Stage C (Full): 100% commit -> cumulative 18% discount + optional committed burst pool
   - Discounts apply at the time the private offer is accepted for that stage. We can set retroactive crediting if early usage exceeds the staged commit (details in the PO).

3) Marketplace publication timeline
   - We can prepare the AWS Private Offer draft in parallel. Typical lead time for listing + legal review is ~2 weeks after commercial terms signoff.

4) Procurement & security checklist
   - Marissa will run our standard Marketplace PO checklist (SOC2 evidence, data residency, KMS notes).

Next actions:
- I’ll circulate Redwood’s MAP template (with acceptance criteria) and a draft private-offer tier table by Monday (Dec 7).
- Rishi will run preliminary capacity sizing and confirm the dedicated pool spec.
- Daniel — please confirm the eval prompts owner and the internal approver for each MAP gate.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

Following up with the sizing and ops notes for the pilot. Quick summary:

- Pilot footprint: 2x A100-equivalent nodes (dedicated) with a warm KV cache layer. That matches the latency targets for text-gen at your average sequence lengths.
- Token budget estimate (4-week): ~1.5M generated tokens across test harness — we'll instrument traces for per-prompt breakdown.
- Fallback policy: during the pilot, if p99 violates for two successive days, we will auto-scale to a temporary burst pool for remediation (no extra charge for first remediation event).

I'll attach the capacity spec and a rough cost model in the MAP template. On discounts: we recommend tying the 10%/18% to objective KPIs (commit percent + sustained QPS) rather than calendar dates to simplify acceptance.

Attachments: Redwood-Marketplace-Offer-Template.pdf

Rishi
